scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser RAM mode and attempt the selected WPA3/SAE profile with PMF required.
expected: The selected BSS passes vendor compatibility checks, SAE and the WPA four-way handshake complete with PMF, and the interface obtains an IP address for data exchange.
observed: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, the scan completed and selected the matching BSS at 13.795 s after kernel boot. SAE commit/confirm succeeded; the supplicant reported Trying then Associated and SUBNET-STATUS-UPDATE status 0. EmberBSD published net80211 RUN (state 4) between 14.696 and 14.783 s. Two SIOCADDMULTI requests returned ENETRESET at 21.422 and 21.452 s without resetting the join. At 24.762 s the vendor transitioned run to init and reported send deauth for 4-way handshake timeout (reason 204); disconnect reason 204 followed at 24.814/24.835 s. No scan or channel-change event was recorded after association. The retained instrumentation does not establish EAPOL delivery or identify a specific handshake step. No WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated key management/PMF, DHCP/DNS or data exchange was observed. A later read-only supplicant status query returned SCANNING.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.
Observed times are kernel uptime; the full capture duration is not established. The private capture and its path are not part of this shared record.
The retained capture does not establish EAPOL delivery or identify the handshake step that failed. No WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, DHCP/DNS or data exchange was established.
The SIOCADDMULTI ENETRESET results did not reset the join in this trial; this does not establish broader multicast behavior.
Sequential log retrieval completed without an observed OOM or trap in this trial; this does not establish broader RAM reliability.
WPA2-only authentication, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
